curves.name: transfer_characteristics_typ_25C
curves.test_conditions: TJ = 25 degC typical trace (a 100 degC companion trace is also drawn; both cross at about -VGS = 2.08 V, -ID = 8 A). The figure states no VDS test condition. Axes plot magnitudes of the negative P-channel quantities.

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus10V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -10 V trace, TA = 25 degC typical. Label unambiguous (topmost, steepest trace). Axes plot magnitudes of negative quantities. Slope near origin about 16 A/V, i.e. about 63 mohm.

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus4p5V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -4.5 V trace, TA = 25 degC typical. Label unambiguous (second steep trace). Slope near origin about 13 A/V, i.e. about 77 mohm, which matches the feature-page RDS(on) assignment rather than the p. 2 table (see extraction notes).

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus2V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -2 V, TA = 25 degC typical. Label assignment: the figure draws five traces but prints only four labels; the '-2V' label sits between two traces. Assigned to the trace saturating near 7.6 A because that is consistent with the Figure 2 transfer curve (about 6.5 A at -VGS = 2.0 V). See extraction notes.

curves.name: output_characteristics_vgs_minus1p5V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -1.5 V, TA = 25 degC typical. Assigned to the lowest trace (the '-1.5V' label is printed directly below it). Note this trace saturates near 4 A while the Figure 2 transfer curve reads only about 0.9 A at -VGS = 1.5 V; the two figures are mutually inconsistent at this gate drive. See extraction notes.

curves.name: rdson_vs_drain_current_vgs_minus4p5V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -4.5 V trace, TA = 25 degC typical. Consistent with the p. 2 table row (57 mohm typ at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -3 A) but not with the p. 1 feature box (74 mohm typ at -4.5 V); see extraction notes.

curves.name: rdson_vs_drain_current_vgs_minus2p5V
curves.test_conditions: VGS = -2.5 V trace, TA = 25 degC typical. Consistent with the p. 2 table row (74 mohm typ at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -2 A).

curves.name: body_diode_forward_characteristics_25C
curves.test_conditions: TJ = 25 degC trace (a TJ = 100 degC companion trace crosses it near -VSD = 1.8 V, -IS = 4 A). VGS = 0 implied by the source-drain diode context; the figure states no explicit bias. Note: this typical trace reads about 1.7 V at -IS = 3 A, which exceeds the p. 2 table maximum of 1.2 V at IS = -3 A; the figure and table are mutually inconsistent. See extraction notes.

curves.name: ciss_vs_vds
curves.test_conditions: VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz implied by the p. 2 capacitance table conditions; the figure axis is C(pF) versus -VDS(V), 0 to 20 V. Trace value at -VDS = 10 V anchors to the table typical Ciss = 503 pF.

curves.name: coss_vs_vds
curves.test_conditions: VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz implied by the p. 2 capacitance table conditions. The Coss and Crss traces nearly merge above -VDS = 5 V, so reads there carry extra uncertainty; the trace at -VDS = 10 V anchors to the table typical Coss = 67 pF.

curves.name: crss_vs_vds
curves.test_conditions: VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz implied by the p. 2 capacitance table conditions. The Crss and Coss traces nearly merge above -VDS = 5 V, so reads there carry extra uncertainty; the trace at -VDS = 10 V anchors to the table typical Crss = 58 pF.

curves.name: gate_charge_characteristics
curves.test_conditions: VDS = -10 V, ID = -2 A (printed on the figure). Miller plateau at -VGS of about 1.5 V from about 0.85 nC to about 1.95 nC; endpoint about -VGS = 4.5 V at 4.1 nC. Consistent with the p. 2 table Qgs = 0.8 nC, Qgd = 1.1 nC, Qg = 4.1 nC at VGS = -4.5 V.

extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: adf34596b68972382184a2e7387d6a3d2e79c4b16bf1d93318a115a3cba503a6 (C385296__AP2301.pdf, 6 pages, All Power Semiconductor Co.,Ltd, rev V1.1).

Extraction method: page 4 rasterized at 300 dpi with pdftoppm; each figure cropped and read visually. Curve points are digitized_typical_curve grade; estimated read accuracy about half a minor gridline (roughly 5 to 10 percent, worse on the log-scale capacitance plot where Coss and Crss nearly merge above 5 V).

Sign convention: this is a P-channel device. Tabulated specs are recorded with the datasheet's printed signs (VGS(th) -0.5/-0.7/-1.0 V, V(BR)DSS -20 V, RDS(on) conditions VGS = -4.5/-2.5 V and ID = -3/-2 A). Figure axes are printed as -ID(A), -VDS(V), -VGS(V), -IS(A), -VSD(V); curve points are the plotted magnitudes along those negated axes, so the sign is carried by the axis quantity label.

Internal RDS(on) contradiction: the p. 1 feature box states RDS(on) < 75 mohm (typ 58) at VGS = -10 V and < 95 mohm (typ 74) at VGS = -4.5 V, while the p. 2 electrical characteristics table states 57 typ / 75 max mohm at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -3 A and 74 typ / 95 max mohm at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -2 A. Figure 3 (about 54 mohm at -4.5 V, about 71 mohm at -2.5 V) supports the table; Figure 1's linear-region slopes (about 63 mohm at -10 V, about 77 mohm at -4.5 V) support the feature box. rdson_points records the normative p. 2 table rows.

Figure 1 (output characteristics) draws five traces but prints only four labels (VGS = -10 V, -4.5 V, -2 V, -1.5 V). The -10 V and -4.5 V labels unambiguously mark the two steep traces. The '-2V' label sits between the trace saturating near 16 A and the trace saturating near 7.6 A; it was assigned to the 7.6 A trace because the Figure 2 transfer curve gives about 6.5 A at -VGS = 2.0 V. The '-1.5V' label was assigned to the lowest trace (label printed directly below it). The unlabeled middle trace (11.9 A at -VDS = 2 V, 16 A at 5 V; consistent with roughly VGS = -2.4 to -2.5 V per the transfer curve) was omitted because its gate voltage is not printed.
Figure 1's -1.5 V trace (saturating near 4 A) is inconsistent with the Figure 2 transfer curve (about 0.9 A at -VGS = 1.5 V); both are recorded as drawn.
The transfer characteristics figure (Figure 2) states no VDS test condition; only the temperature labels 25 degC and 100 degC are printed. The 25 degC trace was digitized.

Body diode: the only tabulated value is the 1.2 V maximum at IS = -3 A; no typical is published. The Figure 4 typical 25 degC curve reads about 1.7 V at 3 A magnitude, which exceeds that tabulated maximum, so the figure and table are mutually inconsistent; both are recorded.
Capacitance curve reads at -VDS = 10 V were anchored against the p. 2 table typicals (Ciss 503 pF, Coss 67 pF, Crss 58 pF) and agree within read error.

Switching times (td(on) 11 ns, tr 52 ns, td(off) 16 ns, tf 10 ns at VDD = -10 V, ID = -3 A, VGS = -4.5 V, RG = 3 ohm) and gate charge table values (Qg 4.1 nC, Qgs 0.8 nC, Qgd 1.1 nC at VDS = -10 V, ID = -2 A, VGS = -4.5 V) are published on p. 2; the schema has no dedicated fields for them, so they are noted here. Gate leakage IGSS max +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V; IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = -20 V. No trr/Qrr row, no RthJC, and no gate resistance row are published; RthJA is 125 degC/W max (p. 1 absolute maximum ratings).
No vendor SPICE model or model pack was used; every value comes from the public datasheet PDF.
